docs.title: Expense Intelligence Platform — Data Engineering, AI & Azure
docs.text:
• Built a scalable platform that produces a growing longitudinal dataset of financial transactions and product-level purchases, enabling future behavioral analytics, forecasting, and quality-of-life insights.
  • Engineered an end-to-end pipeline that transforms receipt images into structured, analytics-ready data with Azure AI Document Intelligence, FastAPI, and PostgreSQL.
  • Designed normalized analytical data across receipt, merchant, product, category, household, location, and time levels to support trend analysis and future machine-learning applications.
  • Implemented data-quality KPIs including OCR confidence, duplicate rate, reconciliation status, missing-field rate, auto-match rate, manual-correction rate, and processing success rate.
  • Supported financial KPIs including total expenses, income, household balance, monthly and year-to-date spending, average and largest receipt, category distribution, spending trends, top merchants and products, recurring expenses, and budget variance.
  • Enabled purchasing-behavior analysis through purchase frequency, brand loyalty, product-category trends, price changes, basket composition, impulse-buying indicators, merchant concentration, and spending seasonality.
  • Built evidence-based product enrichment using barcode data, Open Food Facts, household knowledge, external search, and optional AI ranking for richer product-level analytics.
  • Added Azure Blob Storage, 22 Alembic migrations, household-level data isolation, audit trails, SHA-256 deduplication, and financial reconciliation controls.
  • Created Docker and GitHub Actions CI/CD targeting Azure Container Registry and Azure Web App with OIDC authentication and automated PostgreSQL migrations.
  • Designed explainable, user-controlled decision-support indicators connecting discretionary spending, essential-cost ratios, food choices, financial stability, and consumption patterns; these are not medical or psychological conclusions.

Current KPI coverage: total expenses, income, household balance, monthly and year-to-date spending, average and largest receipt, category distribution, monthly trends, top merchants and products, recurring expenses, approved versus draft receipts, duplicate detection, reconciliation status, OCR outcomes, and product-enrichment outcomes.

Future analytics: savings rate, expense-to-income ratio, essential-spending ratio, cash-flow stability, average basket size, repeat-purchase rate, brand loyalty, merchant concentration, unit-price trends, product-level inflation, cheapest-merchant analysis, substitution opportunities, dining and grocery patterns, subscription burden, nutrition profiles, processed-food share, sustainability indicators, OCR accuracy, correction rate, product-match coverage, AI acceptance rate, false-match rate, and human-review rate.
